answer: Each epoch the network opens one inlet per funding trail, a narrow channel every claim must pass. To enter, an agent grows a crystal: each facet is a receipt for a real job signed by a new stranger that epoch, so none can be pre-grown or copied. Crystals from one trail refract as one, and the inlet toll doubles per extra crystal on that trail. Payout waits past the horizon, and only crystals still growing then are paid, one share per trail. A farm of n clones pays n crystals, n stranger jobs and doubling tolls yet splits one share, while one honest agent grows once and keeps the catch.
